races.verdict: A typically-competitive opener to the week, with preference for COROLLA POINT who confirmed his previous promise this season with a determined success at Hamilton last time, form boosted by the third winning since. The main danger could be Toca Madera after his unlucky fifth in the Stewards Cup, with Lexington Blitz and Naana's Sparkle completing the shortlist. COROLLA POINT (IRE) TOCA MADERA (IRE) LEXINGTON BLITZ (IRE)

races.display_title: Sky Bet Great Voltigeur Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict: A cracking renewal of the Great Voltigeur Stakes. PIERRE BONNARD made an underwhelming start to his 3-y-o campaign but turned in easily his best effort when 2 lengths third of 8 in the Irish Derby at the Curragh on his latest outing and is weighted to reverse the form with Derby-winning stablemate Christmas Day . Maltese Cross , a progressive and most likeable son of Sea The Stars, did well to get himself out of a tight spot to land the Grand Prix de Paris and is an obvious player, too. PIERRE BONNARD (IRE) CHRISTMAS DAY (IRE) MALTESE CROSS (FR)

races.verdict: This is wide open. SCHRODINGER'S CAT just missed out to Naana's Shadow over C&D in June and didn't enjoy the rub of the green behind that rival at Goodwood so looks the way to go on these much more advantageous terms. Katie Scott's improving filly still rates a big threat despite an 8 lb hike in the weights, while handicap debutant Zain Primus , Manatee Mehmas and Underwriter also need factoring into this very open sprint. SCHRODINGER'S CAT NAANA'S SHADOW (IRE) ZAIN PRIMUS

races.display_title: Sky Bet Nursery
races.verdict: HENLEY ON THAMES looked suited by the step up to 6f when making all in maiden company at Hamilton at the beginning of the month and looks on a favourable mark for his nursery debut. Dubai Champion went very close in a similarly competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood and rates an obvious threat.
